tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Тед подзвонив Вікторії й чесно розповів про повідомлення від Робін. Вікторія сказала, що вони мусять розійтися. Тепер Тед сидить за стійкою, а друзі по черзі пояснюють, що він мав зробити, що міг би зробити, що зробили б вони і що взагалі не треба було робити. Ти наливаєш і слухаєш.
tasks.q_pl: Ted zadzwonił do Victorii i szczerze opowiedział o wiadomości od Robin. Victoria powiedziała, że muszą się rozstać. Teraz Ted siedzi przy barze, a przyjaciele po kolei tłumaczą, co powinien był zrobić, co mógł zrobić, co oni by zrobili i czego w ogóle nie trzeba było robić. Nalewasz i słuchasz.
tasks.q_en: Ted called Victoria and honestly told her about Robin's text. Victoria said they had to break up. Now Ted is sitting at the bar, and the friends take turns explaining what he should have done, what he could have done, what they would have done, and what he needn't have done at all. You pour and listen.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Past modals: modal + have + past participle. should have = it was the right thing, but it didn't happen (He should have told Robin). could have = a possibility that wasn't used (He could have acted differently). would have = what I would have done in that situation (I'd have done the same). needn't have = you did it, but it wasn't necessary (He needn't have bought such expensive flowers). Compare: didn't need to = it wasn't necessary (and maybe you didn't do it).
tasks.q_pl: Past modals: modal + have + past participle. should have = it was the right thing, but it didn't happen (He should have told Robin). could have = a possibility that wasn't used (He could have acted differently). would have = what I would have done in that situation (I'd have done the same). needn't have = you did it, but it wasn't necessary (He needn't have bought such expensive flowers). Compare: didn't need to = it wasn't necessary (and maybe you didn't do it).

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Тед киває: «Дякую. Мені треба було це почути». Він залишає чайові й іде додому — уперше за тиждень не озираючись на телефон.
end_good.text_pl: Ted kiwa głową: „Dzięki. Musiałem to usłyszeć”. Zostawia napiwek i idzie do domu — pierwszy raz od tygodnia nie oglądając się na telefon.
end_good.text_en: Ted nods: “Thanks. I needed to hear that.” He leaves a tip and goes home, for the first time in a week without checking his phone.

tasks.q_en: Ted asks you: “And what do you think?” Answer honestly and accurately. He trusts your opinion.

tasks.label: ФІНАЛ
tasks.q: Згадай ситуацію, коли все пішло не так (70+ слів): що ти мав би зробити, що міг би зробити, що зробили б інші і що було зайвим.
tasks.q_pl: Przypomnij sobie sytuację, kiedy wszystko poszło nie tak (70+ słów): co powinieneś był zrobić, co mogłeś zrobić, co zrobiliby inni i co było zbędne.
tasks.q_en: Think of a time when things went wrong (70+ words): what you should have done, what you could have done, what others would have done, and what you needn't have done.
tasks.tip: I should have… I could have… My friend would have… I needn't have…
